question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is '**Reffere**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Reffere**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Referee**'.
 
• It means 'a person who gives information about your character and ability, usually in a letter, for example when you are hoping to be chosen for a job'. [किसी की (जैसे नौकरी के उम्‍मीदवार की) योग्‍यता आदि को (प्रायः पत्र द्वारा) प्रमाणित करने वाला व्‍यक्ति; रेफ़र]
 
 
• *Example: Her teacher agreed to act as her **referee**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Reffere.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Negotiate**: to talk to somebody in order to decide or agree about something. (किसी मुद्दे पर निर्णय या समझौते के लिए किसी से बातचीत करना; परक्रामण करना)
 
• **Miraculous**: completely unexpected and very lucky. (सर्वथा अप्रत्‍याशित और बहुत शुभ; चमत्‍कारपूर्ण)
 
• **Satellite**: an electronic device that is sent into space and moves around the earth or another planet for a particular purpose. [कृत्रिम उपग्रह (विशेष प्रयोजन से अंतरिक्ष में भेजा गया इलेक्‍ट्रॉनिक उपकरण जो पृथ्‍वी या अन्‍य ग्रह की परिक्रमा करता है)]
